profile.name: Andor 科学级制冷 CCD/EMCCD 相机
profile.description: 这是一类用于低光成像与光谱测量的科学级制冷相机，配有 CCD 或 EMCCD 探测器，可控制制冷、快门、触发、曝光、读出速度、增益、分箱和多种采集模式。在显微成像、荧光检测、拉曼/发射光谱及其他需要低噪声高灵敏探测的实验中常用。
profile.description_en: This is a family of scientific cooled cameras using CCD or EMCCD detectors for low-light imaging and spectroscopy. They support control of cooling, shuttering, triggering, exposure, readout speed, gain, binning, and multiple acquisition modes. They are commonly used in microscopy, fluorescence detection, Raman or emission spectroscopy, and other experiments requiring low-noise, high-sensitivity detection.

registry.name: CCD Camera/Detector
registry.description: CCD Camera/Detector是一款表征设备，主要功能包括中止、传输、使能、冷却、初始化、启动。支持EM gain, EM gain mode, EM gain range等操作。
